svg.title: ROUTER TEMPLATE — acrylic, for the 24 mm frame
svg.desc: Cut. Every aperture is already grown by 2.38125 for a 5/16in OD guide bushing with a 1/8in bit — do NOT add compensation in xTool. Cuts the hand hole, the three bays and the three bays; the O260 perimeter is file 9. Three 4.5 holes at R96 screw it to the blank. Engrave layer is reference only.
